# Test fixtures

Small crops of MapleStory Classic World's screen (the EXP readout, the level box, a map name, the
inventory, the quickslot and a megaphone's channel badge, without the sender or message), taken from the developer's own play. The reader tests in `src/read/`
read them and check the values in their file names. The game's art and text are © Nexon; they're
here only so the readers can be tested, and aren't covered by this repository's MIT license.
